stem: Danny would like to add a relevant quotation to the end of the third paragraph (sentences 17-22). Which of the following could best follow sentence 22 and help support the ideas in this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: “He hangs out with Cameron every weekend,” Mack’s mom noted.

options.label: B
options.text: “I just felt like it needed to be done,” Mack said, “so I did it.”

options.label: C
options.text: “High school has been just great,” Mack commented.

options.label: D
options.text: “Mack was nice to me and really funny,” Cameron explained.
